notes: Dockerfile.final created successfully. The Dockerfile uses rust:1.70-slim-bookworm as base image, installs required system packages (git, curl, pkg-config, libssl-dev, ca-certificates), copies setup_runtime.sh and repo_setup.sh to /opt/benchmark/, runs repo_setup.sh first to materialize /workspace from the Apache Arrow Rust repository, then runs setup_runtime.sh to install Rust toolchain and fetch dependencies. The final WORKDIR is set to /workspace. The eval.sh and hidden tests are intentionally NOT baked into the image - they are runtime-mounted verifier assets as per the workflow requirements. The container_build_plan.json has been written as the structured source of truth for the rendered container specs. Ready for Buildah validation.
